remarks: This five bedroom Classic Colonial, updated throughout and located on a beautiful cul-de-sac in the popular Rosebrook area, is set on a park-like professionally landscaped two+acre parcel. Formal front to back living room w/ fireplace and dining room, sparkling white eat-in kitchen, family room, oversized study w/fireplace, one of two primary suites, a laundry room, as well as a great screened-in porch complete the first floor. Upstairs, there is another primary suite, a bedroom with bath and two other bedrooms by an updated hall bath. Storage galore is in a huge attic space on the second floor. The lower level has a playroom and billiard room. Flagstone terrace runs behind the home with an included fire pit and heat lamp. This offering provides excellent living interior, as well as exterior spaces for family and friends. Stone walls around the back exudes what makes New England so desired. Close to everything, but a world apart.
